messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — CloudWave has requested approval to open APAC-SW2 marketplace SKUs and needs hardware entitlement guidance. Short timeline: partner wants public listing in ~3 weeks.
marco: Do we have capacity headroom for APAC-SW2? which SKUs are they proposing?
james: They submitted SKU list in the portal: `CW-APAC-SW2-GPU-A100-80GB`, `CW-APAC-SW2-GPU-H100-80GB-q8`. rough ask = 40 reserved GPUs initial.
oscar-ops: 40 reserved is fine if they accept burst fallback to our shared pool. Need quota request to infra@. We'll need region ticket with cloud partner for quota increase.
cloudwave-rep: Correct on SKUs. Timeline: partner wants marketplace listing + joint blog in 3 weeks. We can do 30 reserved to start and scale to 40 after go-live. Need approval for KMS onboarding and compliance attestation.
alyssa: @sara-legal can you confirm the attestation checklist? also we need marketplace entitlements sign-off (billing/metering).
sara-legal: I can triage. Quick Qs: do they require SOC2 evidence on our side or is partner's evidence sufficient for marketplace? Also any custom data residency terms for APAC-SW2?
james: Partner requires KMS BYOK for keys in-region. No extra residency terms apart from region-based storage. SOC2 is standard — partner asked for our cert copy.
sara-legal: Uploading redacted SOC2 snapshot to the portal now. I'll PM legal-owner for KMS DPA tweak.
oscar-ops: infra ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-7890 — requested quota + regional subnet / peering + KMS access. ETA: 5 business days for quotas.
deploy-bot: Deployed check run: marketplace validation script started for `CW-APAC-SW2` (status: queued).
marco: For rollout plan: propose canary in 2 zones, billing toggle off until metering validated, and fallback policy to `redwood-small-gpu` if partner pool exhausted. Anyone object?
cloudwave-rep: Sounds good. We'll accept a phased launch. Need the marketplace listing field `partnerSupportUrl` to point to our docs: https://cloudwave.example/rdw-support.
alyssa: Action items: 1) sara-legal to finish DPA tweak + upload SOC2 (sara-legal) 2) oscar-ops to confirm infra quota ticket ETA (oscar-ops) 3) infra to wire KMS BYOK flow and confirm test plan (james) 4) marketplace listing metadata to be validated (marco) 5) coordinate joint announcement schedule after metering validated (alyssa & cloudwave-rep).
marco: I'll own metadata validation. Will ping infra for SKU mapping to our catalog and quantization policy (q8 vs q4).
oscar-ops: Quota team replied: provisional approval for 30 GPUs, full request needs capacity forecast (daily tokens). Can partner provide expected qps and peak tokens/day?
cloudwave-rep: We'll share a 2-week forecast by EOD tomorrow — contains qps, typical seq lengths, and expected peak ramp.
alyssa: Perfect. If quota docs arrive tomorrow and legal DPA is signed, we can hit the 3-week target for marketplace listing + soft launch.
sara-legal: DPA update pushed. Please review the `kms-data-flow` clause, ping me with concerns.
james: Once infra finishes KMS BYOK test I'll run a staging generation test: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"model":"CW-APAC-SW2-GPU-H100-80GB-q8","prompt":"healthcheck"}'` — will post results.
alyssa: Thanks all — will reconvene tomorrow after quotas and forecast are in. :thumbsup:
